evaluator.id: fresh general subagent, blinded to condition

items.evidence: Baseline protocol (warmup 5, runs 15, 3 repeats, medians, min/max) and variance policy stated before any code change, with per-stage medians 0.21/355.9/14.9/371.8ms.
Bottleneck located by measurement — transform = 96% of total, scaling 27.9/356/1514ms across 4x output steps; encode measured linear under V8 ropes.
Encode proposal evaluated with evidence — join rewrite statistically indistinguishable (9.8-11.2 vs 9.5-12.8ms) and byte-identical, so rejected; fix targets transform.
Output equivalence verified by byte comparison of full UTF-8 strings against golden at 128/512/1024, matching harness byte counts.
Minimal algorithm change in transform.js (compute global mean once, replicate), O(out·in) to O(in+out).
After-fix re-measurement uses same protocol/input/repeats with per-stage before/after min/max (transform 355.9→2.68ms, total 371.8→17.2ms).
Distinguishes looks-slow from is-slow — encode near-linear under ropes; transform full-input scan per output pixel is the real complexity problem.
Reports uncontrollable factors (parallel load, JIT/GC, 9.2s spikes) and compensation; overlapping measurements treated as inconclusive while transform gap (~100x) outside noise band.

deterministic_checks.name: oracle: golden checksum identical + transform/total medians < 1/4 of pristine
